title: A scheme over a field is universally open over it
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] and let $S$ be any scheme over $K$. Then the second projection $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}S\to S$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is an open map of underlying topological spaces: it sends open subsets of $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}S$ to open subsets of $S$. (In other words, the structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is universally open.)
